problema.title: How many hours do you lose each week on tasks that don't require your expertise?
problema.text: Requests for information. Appointments to confirm by hand. The same client questions, every day. Reminders no one sends. These are necessary tasks, but repetitive. And together they add up to precious hours every week, time taken away from what matters: your clients and your business.

problema.title: Every day your salon loses requests and appointments without realizing it

items.title: After-hours requests
items.text: Many requests come in during the evening or on weekends, when the salon is closed. Without an automatic reply, the client books elsewhere.

items.title: Missed appointments
items.text: In this industry around 15% of appointments fall through without notice. Every no-show is lost time and lost revenue.

items.title: The same questions every day
items.text: Prices, availability, treatment duration: the same questions repeated, stealing hours from the front desk.

soluzione.title: AutomaIA takes care of it for you
soluzione.intro: I build automations tailored to your salon. You touch nothing technical: you only use the result.

items.title: Booking always open
items.text: Clients book their own appointment, at any hour. You find your calendar already filled in.

items.title: Automatic reminders
items.text: A reminder by SMS and email before every appointment. No-shows drop almost to zero.

items.title: FAQ assistant 24/7
items.text: An assistant answers recurring questions about prices, availability and services, around the clock.

esempio.title: A concrete example
esempio.text: A beauty salon with a front desk staffed only in the morning was losing every request in the afternoon and on weekends. With online booking and automatic reminders, no-shows dropped by 60% and the front desk now handles twice as many clients.
